intro: The Old Gods are colossal, parasitic horrors of flesh and madness that plummeted from the cosmos during Azeroth's primordial dawn. Though vanquished and bound deep beneath the crust by the Titans, their ancient whispers still corrode mortal minds, twist nature, and drive doomsday cults to unearth their prisons.

p: Long before mortal records began, Azeroth was dominated by the Old Gods, colossal entities of chaotic flesh such as C'Thun. They embedded themselves into the planet's crust, commanding elemental armies and insectoid swarms. When the Titans arrived, their armies fought an apocalyptic war against them. Rather than destroying them, the Titans bound the Old Gods in vast, subterranean prisons to keep them dormant forever.

Even chained beneath miles of stone and enchanted wards, the Old Gods have never truly slept. Their psychic malice seeps continually into the world, corrupting the vulnerable. It was their collective malice that slowly drove Neltharion the Earth-Warder mad during the War of the Ancients, twisting the noble dragon into Deathwing. When Queen Azshara and her Highborne drowned beneath the raging waters of the Great Sundering, an Old God answered their desperation, transforming them into the serpentine naga. Furthermore, their insidious taint has breached the Emerald Dream, twisting druidic realms into the creeping terror known as the Emerald Nightmare.
